name: Flagship gnocchi product architecture and recipe-capture model
scope: Pure local immutable prototype capture; no persistence or activation.

concepts.prototypeCapture: Observed experiment/cooking run; the only newly implemented concept.
concepts.canonicalRecipe: Production definition; existing FoodRecipeDraft remains unchanged.
concepts.recipeVersion: Controlled canonical iteration; capture does not create or rewrite it.
concepts.product: Distinct intended customer item; optional exact existing reference, not sale authority.
concepts.component: Reusable culinary preparation; deferred FOOD-003B system.
concepts.packageSku: Sellable format/quantity; not an observed yield.
concepts.nutritionProfile: Derived nutrient data; no calculation here.
concepts.preparationInstructions: Customer workflow; experimental method/notes are not customer instructions.

contract.identity: food-prototype-capture:<local> uses existing FOOD prefix/local-ID conventions; no generated IDs or capture revision system.
contract.references: Optional recipe id/version requires matching validated supplied recipe snapshot. Optional product requires that recipe plus matching validated product snapshot. Context-free experiments are allowed. Unused supplied snapshots are rejected. No remote existence claims.
contract.ingredients: Ordered nonempty input list; unique bounded run-local keys, descriptive ingredient names, positive finite grams no greater than MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Fractional grams preserved without rounding. Optional zero-based recipeIngredientIndex must match the supplied exact recipe ingredient name. Repeated names are allowed only with distinct keys; no merging.
contract.method: Nonempty ordered bounded text steps recording actual actions.
contract.adjustments: Ordered text process changes or add/remove mass records referencing a known input key. They never overwrite starting measurements. Adjustment-only ingredients may be declared with the mass adjustment's ingredientName instead of inputKey. This is an event record, not mass balance calculation.
contract.yield: Positive finite finishedYieldGrams; observed result, never SKU/package promise.
contract.observations: Ordered bounded category/text pairs, open category labels; empty list allowed.
contract.provenance: Required founder-measured kind and opaque sourceReference, optional occurredOn using validateFoodReviewDate. Supplied provenance is attribution, not verified measurement truth. Reference/inferred/calculated/canonicalized data is not accepted as measurement provenance. Existing FoodEvidence requirements are neither satisfied nor modified.
contract.immutability: Strict boundary validation, detached nested values and recursive freezing; no retained caller objects.
contract.limits: 128 inputs, 128 steps, 128 adjustments, 128 observations; 128-character keys/categories, 256-character ingredient names, 2000-character notes, 512-character source reference.
contract.futureUse: May later provide source material/evidence for deliberate canonical updates; no automatic recipe/version creation, publication or sale authorization.

validationGates: Strict bounded TypeScript check of capture module/tests and imported draft domain
boundaries: Synthetic fixtures only. No real gnocchi recipe, nutrition/cost/commerce, reusable components, persistence/schema/migrations, routes/UI, Cloudflare/D1/KV actions, deployment, commit or push. FOOD-002ZN operational completion is owner supplied; no ceremony reconstructed.
